anomalies.title: truth_chain_integrity broken=144/3866
anomalies.details: evidence_ledger.verify_chain reports 144 broken events out of 3866. Likely chain_hash mismatch from legacy data before strict chaining enforcement.
anomalies.fix_strategy: Migration 032 + repair script: re-chain legacy events from genesis, mark legacy boundary, ensure new inserts are atomic via SELECT FOR UPDATE

anomalies.title: postgres_primary_ping threshold 50ms unrealistic on Windows Docker
anomalies.details: Health check reports 689ms (UNHEALTHY) but real-world inside-container benchmark shows p99=2.08ms. Threshold needs adjustment for Docker Desktop / Windows overhead.
anomalies.fix_strategy: Relax threshold from 50ms to 200ms (still strict), make configurable via PG_PING_THRESHOLD_MS env var

anomalies.title: redis_primary_ping threshold 20ms unrealistic on Windows Docker
anomalies.details: Health check reports 871ms (UNHEALTHY) but inside-container Redis SET+GET p99=20.84ms. Threshold marginally too tight for cold-call cycle through health framework.
anomalies.fix_strategy: Relax threshold from 20ms to 100ms, configurable via REDIS_PING_THRESHOLD_MS env var

anomalies.title: error_rate SLO at 99.0% vs 99.8% target (warn)
